notablePrerequisites: All modes but "Abandon Ship" have been chosen for Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a permanent that shares a type with the one you intend to donate.
description:
Cast Role Reversal by paying {U}{U}{R}, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Kobayashi Maru Scenario.
At the beginning of that opponent's upkeep, they are forced to choose the "Abandon Ship" mode and lose the game.
